convention.check_matrix: H=(A B | C D ; 0 0 | B^T A^T)

distance_problem.definition: min symplectic weight over S^perp \ S
distance_problem.nontriviality: For v in S^perp, v is outside S iff its pairing functional on S^perp/S is nonzero. A nonzero functional evaluates to 1 on some member of any spanning family; the selected translated representatives span the full 24-dimensional quotient.
distance_problem.timeout_policy: UNKNOWN/MODEL_INVALID/timeout remains partial and never exact

small_weight_exclusion.method: exact Python-integer GF(2) syndrome meet-in-the-middle over all 3n single-qubit X/Z/Y atoms; distinct-qubit filters enforce symplectic weight

solver_protocol.canonical_gate: matching proof-complete representative records (CP-SAT INFEASIBLE or PySAT UNSAT on the equisatisfiable CNF) whose transported dual rank is 24 in both GF(2) paths, plus independently checked weight-12 witness
independent_backends: PySAT cadical195 on the equisatisfiable Tseitin-XOR + seqcounter CNF (proof-complete status UNSAT); frozen amendment 2026-08-15, before any completed sector record existed; SAT models re-verified through both GF(2) paths; cross-backend contradictions fail-stop the campaign

translation_orbit_reduction.coverage_argument: If a nonzero quotient class v existed below the cap, nondegeneracy gives a covered functional f with <v,f>_s=1. Translation transports representative infeasibility to every f in its orbit while preserving centralizer membership and weight.
translation_orbit_reduction.permutation_convention: old qubit (block,i,j) maps to (block,i+delta_i mod 12,j+delta_j mod 6); same on x and z

weight_six_classification.method: exact Python-integer GF(2) triple-triple syndrome meet-in-the-middle over all 3n single-qubit atoms; qubit-disjoint filters enforce symplectic weight exactly 6; every distinct collision vector re-verified to have zero syndrome and classified against the stabilizer row space by independent bitset and NumPy paths
